title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Ram TRX
description:
The Ram TRX Launch Edition was limited to seven hundred two trucks. The engine makes seven hundred two horsepower. That is not a coincidence we can prove or disprove, but it is a fact worth knowing, and it is the first of two things you probably did not know about the Ram TRX. The second is a ranking that the truck earned three years in a row, and it has nothing to do with speed. We read Wikipedia, Motor1, Motor Authority, Edmunds, Kelley Blue Book, Ford Authority's report of a MotorTrend test, and Ram's own press release. Where figures conflict, and for this truck they often do, we show both. Anything we calculate is labelled as our arithmetic, and anything Ram or Ford says about its own truck is marked as a claim.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
